node_addins.command: node --test web-ui/app.test.js web-ui/auth.test.js powerpoint-addin/taskpane.test.js word-addin/word-taskpane.test.js word-addin/dev-server.test.js

observations: insertSlidesFromBase64 inserts at the beginning; insertPlan inserts in reverse with targetSlideId and fills slides in deck order.
Outline parser tolerates a short preamble, '# Slide N - title' labels and 'Title:'/'Bullet text:' prefixes; code fences and JSON are rejected.
Model v3 produced wrong slide counts (1, 2, 4, 6) and occasionally altered facts in repeated runs; the pane rejects count mismatches before any write and shows a reviewable proposal otherwise.
The deck was an unsaved test presentation (Presentation1); slides were exported to PNG for evidence. No file was written to the repository except the template and evidence assets.
